scope: Ten remaining current variants; excludes two already refined and superseded attempts.

jobs.prompt: Refine this exact BrineSpace L-shaped corner furniture to match our matte hand-painted industrial family. Preserve its exact orientation, outer L footprint, straight horizontal top wall-contact edge and straight vertical outer wall-contact return. Preserve all objects, cabinet types, substantial front height and worktop depth. Improve painted material depth with restrained broad tonal variation, inset panel shading and readable contact seams. Clarify the long return's narrow INNER vertical side with a subdued dark plane and visible top lip, staying INSIDE original silhouette. No taper or projections on outer wall edges. Keep existing neutral local colors; reduce bright continuous rim highlights and polished sheen, especially tools, canisters, appliances and metal trim. Keep foliage matte where present. Sparse readable detail at 345x285 library-pixel export, not more scratches or noise. Same elevated cutaway camera. Full silhouette with margin on true transparent background and inner corner. No new items, people, text, actual room walls, floor or exterior cast shadow.
